request.prompt:
Create a new “八人持续压杠” overall PROP diagram from approved originals. Image 1 gives stone identity, image 2 gives beam identity, image 3 gives only the snake's broad dark bands. The whole stone body from IMAGE 1 remains connected and intact: two flat front roof slabs, barred southern small door, northern sliding panel, rear roofed short section and rock. The long round grey-brown beam from IMAGE 2 crosses IN FRONT of both posts as one uninterrupted log. A SINGLE SHORT HORIZONTAL CLEAT, fixed to the MOVING panel and ending well inside the posts, is directly behind the beam. TWO tight short hemp loops hug the beam AND this cleat at the centre. Nothing is tied to either fixed post. Keep stone lids knee-high and wood beam above them. No extra braces, separate rope anchor blocks, hanging ropes or high stone side walls. CRITICAL visible change to IMAGE 1: completely DELETE the original locking rod, INCLUDING BOTH little round cylindrical ends protruding outside the two posts. There must be NO wooden dowel or round stub at the outside edge of either post. Show an EMPTY dark circular bore on the visible outer side of the right post; the left post's outer contour is straight and clean with no protrusion. No round wooden plug inside a hole. Remove the whole rod, not just its centre.
Main requirement is EXACTLY EIGHT people, with the following unambiguous arrangement: FOUR heads in one SINGLE row on the WEST/left beam half, and FOUR heads in one SINGLE row on the EAST/right beam half. Both groups stand on the SAME camera-near side of the log; nobody stands behind the log, behind another person, or behind the gate. The entire background behind the two single rows is empty. Space the figures evenly, one torso and one pair of feet per head. No extra central person, spectator or hidden helper. Count four on left + four on right before finalizing.
All eight are neutral grey clothed anatomy silhouettes used only to show the prop's force positions. They lean forward from the hips over the log, front shoulders/chests pressing DOWN, arms hanging down past it and knees flexed, feet planted outside the stone body. Do not pose anyone lifting or carrying it on the back of the neck. Each head is separately visible above the corresponding torso. Slightly elevated front-south perspective with adequate horizontal room for both rows.
Gate panel is partly lowered onto the snake and cannot reach bottom. A tiny labelled “内部示意” translucent patch beside the northern gate may reveal the retained snake body; this is a diagram, never a physical new opening. Preserve full roof contours. South feeding door closed and barred. The eight-person count must be in the drawing itself; no text-only substitute. One complete 16:9 landscape overall prop reference, same muted grey/brown line-and-flat-paint style, restrained texture and pale ground. All beam ends, full stone outline and rock visible. South in foreground, north at rear; no photograph, clutter, gore or decoration. Highest native output only.
